The trailer arrives at `actualLocation` (default: the destination); a location other than the destination needs a `deviationNote` (422 `unexplained-destination`). Only the lease holder completes a HOSTLER move (409 `not-lease-holder`); a gate clerk or dock operator completes a VISITING_DRIVER move without `hostlerRef`. The trailer and the move change in one transaction; an occupied destination is refused (409 `location-occupied`) and the move stays CLAIMED.
